description: Retrieval quality evaluation set for the 3-books + transcripts corpus. Each entry is a query that should retrieve content from at least one of the expected_sources within the top-k. A query 'passes' if any expected source appears in top-k retrieval results. Note: this corpus is ~88% YouTube transcripts and ~12% book chunks, so even a perfectly working retrieval may legitimately surface a transcript instead of the expected book. Treat pass rate as directional rather than absolute.
